# Psalm 135 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Praise Yah! Praise the-name-of YHWH; praise O-servants-of YHWH,

**2** Who-stand in-house-of YHWH, in-courts-of house-of our-God.

**3** Praise Yah for good YHWH; sing-praises to-his-name for pleasant.

**4** For Jacob has-chosen for-himself Yah, Israel for-his-treasured-possession.

**5** For I know that great YHWH, and-our-Lord above-all gods.

**6** All which pleased YHWH he-has-done, in-the-heavens and-in-the-earth, in-the-seas and-all the-depths.

**7** Causing-to-rise clouds from-end-of the-earth; lightning for-the-rain he-has-made; bringing-out wind from-his-storehouses.

**8** Who-struck the-firstborn-of Egypt, from-man to beast.

**9** He-sent signs and-wonders in-your-midst O-Egypt, on-Pharaoh and-on-all his-servants.

**10** Who-struck nations many, and-killed kings mighty:

**11** Sihon king-of the-Amorites, and-Og king-of Bashan, and-all kingdoms-of Canaan.

**12** And-he-gave their-land an-inheritance, an-inheritance for-Israel his-people.

**13** O-YHWH your-name to-forever; O-YHWH your-remembrance to-generation and-generation.

**14** For will-judge YHWH his-people, and-concerning his-servants he-will-have-compassion.

**15** The-idols-of the-nations silver and-gold, work-of hands-of man.

**16** Mouth to-them and-not they-speak; eyes to-them and-not they-see.

**17** Ears to-them and-not they-give-ear; also there-is-no breath in-their-mouth.

**18** Like-them will-be those-making-them, all who trusts in-them.

**19** O-house-of Israel bless YHWH; O-house-of Aaron bless YHWH.

**20** O-house-of Levi bless YHWH; fearers-of YHWH bless YHWH.

**21** Blessed YHWH from-Zion, the-one-dwelling Jerusalem. Praise Yah!

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **135:7**: 'Wind from-his-storehouses' — God stores wind like treasure; creation managed with intentionality and abundance.

- **135:15-18**: Repeats the idol polemic from Psalm 115:4-8 nearly verbatim — a liturgical refrain against idolatry.

— EMET
